create_fallback_filesystem: create a FallbackFileSystem wrapping an underlying filesystem with a base root directory
set_fallback_root: set a fallback root directory to populate placeholder files and lazy-load stats from backup
open_file_with_fallback: open a file for reading that triggers lazy loading from the fallback backup location
cat_file_with_fallback: read the contents of a file that auto-loads from fallback if it is a zero-byte placeholder
ls_with_fallback_stats: list directory contents and update file stats from the fallback registry for unloaded files
